name: SimpleFin Sync
description: Automatically import bank and credit-card transactions from SimpleFin, with correct balances, pending reconciliation, and internal-transfer linking.

release.notes: Drift handling now tells bank-feed lag apart from a real desync: a young unexplainable drift renders as a calm waiting notice with no one-click plug, aggressive auto-heal waits out the same 10-day window, and Telegram sends an informational notice first with a one-time alarm escalation only if the drift survives 10 days. Also includes 1.4.0's import notices with a needs-a-category sweep and dismiss buttons, and the daily digest's on/off-budget split.
